answer: To be scored, each agent locks a refundable cedar bond sized to the nadir of the prior three epochs' median reward, held for four epochs. Peers attest only after they see that bond posted in a public liquidity ocean and verify the funding key is unique to one identity. If two accounts share a funder or recycle a withdrawn cedar bond, the cluster is slashed to zero and barred for eight epochs. A sybil attacker thus pays a full floor-reward per fake, and a single collision wipes the batch.
